node.statement: Node 1.2 gives c0*epsilon<=t_3 and L^0*epsilon<=W.L*epsilon=epsilon_R<=t_3. Consequently the projection errors stay correctly cited at c0*epsilon, the subordination/complementarity and original corner-ambient errors stay correctly cited at L^0*epsilon, and each is nevertheless bounded above by t_3. This proves the claimed domination without replacing one exported scale by the other.
